title: Anamnesis - Production RAG Medical Study Assistant
tagline: An AI study assistant that answers medical students' questions from curated textbooks, deployed in production on AWS.

gallery.label: Architecture
gallery.alt: Architecture diagram: React on CloudFront and S3, FastAPI on ECS Fargate, hybrid retrieval with Pinecone and BM25, cross-encoder reranker, LLM generation, response cache and RDS PostgreSQL, deployed with GitHub Actions and ECR

gallery.label: Retrieval eval
gallery.alt: Bar chart of Recall@5 on 100 paraphrased questions: BM25 only 0.53, Hybrid 0.82, Hybrid plus rerank (production) 0.94, Dense only 0.98

gallery.label: App
gallery.alt: Anamnesis sign-in screen: ask questions against your class library

bullets: Full-stack RAG app: FastAPI in Docker on AWS ECS Fargate (ECR), React + TypeScript on S3 + CloudFront, RDS PostgreSQL and Pinecone, shipped with GitHub Actions CI/CD.

Own LangChain-based RAG library: hybrid retrieval (Sentence Transformers + BM25), cross-encoder reranking, configurable chunking and conversation memory; Gemini Flash plus gpt-oss-120B/20B and Qwen models.
Evaluated retrieval with Recall@K, MRR and nDCG (paired-bootstrap CIs) over 6,665 chunks and 150 labelled queries, and generation with RAGAS; ablations showed the reranker adds +12 points Recall@5.
Two-tier response cache: exact hits return in 0.14 ms instead of 3.3 s and save ~1,340 tokens per repeat question.

title: TR Ledger - Debt & Bill Reminder App
tagline: An offline-first Flutter mobile app for TR Clothings that tracks bills, cheque payments and recurring debts, and reminds the owner before each due date.
imageAlt: TR Ledger dashboard showing total outstanding, this month's payments and an overdue alert
bullets: Flutter app with Riverpod state management, a Drift (SQLite) local database and go_router navigation; all data stays on the device.
One-time and recurring debts (daily, monthly on a set day or a custom interval), with schedules anchored to the original due date so a late payment never shifts future dates.
Local notifications 7, 5, 3 and 1 day before each due date, re-armed on every launch because Android drops scheduled alarms when an app is force-stopped.
Dashboard with summary cards, month filter and overdue banner, plus payment history and a decoder for the shop's price codes.
